pair_directions.finding: a_only_correct counts corrections by a relative to b; b_only_correct counts losses, and their difference equals n*(accuracy_a-accuracy_b). Different wrong-class predictions remain in both_wrong and are separately counted as prediction_changes. Equalities use exact saved values without outcome-tuned tolerance.
